learning_outcomes.text: Students know the machine elements springs.
Students are familiar with combinations of springs and can summarize this in a spring characteristic curve.
Students are familiar with the design of screws and bolted connections.
Students can design bolted connections using the VDI guideline VDI 2230.
Students know the different forms of gearing.
Students can determine the geometric parameters of an involute gearing.
Students know the damage patterns of gearings.
Students can perform strength calculations for gearings.
Students are familiar with the basics of clutches.
Students know engineering fundamentals in the areas of strength of materials and machine elements.
Students can understand, explain, and apply technical standard calculations.
Students are familiar with computer-aided design of machine elements.
Students can transfer knowledge/skills to specific mechanical engineering / engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Deepening and application of fundamentals of strength of materials
Screws and bolted connections as machine elements
Application of calculation regulations according to relevant standards
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the written exam. The grade's contribution to the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
